title: bcwsft 0.0.1
text: Complete R port BC Wildfire Service fuel-typing algorithm (Greene’s bcwft2018.py; Perrakis et al. 2018), arcpy-free. full decision tree (non-vegetated vegetated branches) now implemented; vegetated branch transpiled reference Python data-raw/transpile.py validated reference output across thousands random VRI rows (0 mismatches). bcwsft_fuel_type() assigns FBP fuel types data frame VRI records. bcwsft_fuel_type_one() assigns FBP fuel type single VRI record.
